title: release train weekly prep - go/no-go checklist
content:
Weekly release-train prep notes (running list)
Owner: Jordan Lee
Meeting: Release train readiness sync - weekly (Thu 10:00PT)
Date (notes): 2026-03-04

Agenda (10m):
- Quick status roundup (infra / build / QA / docs / PM) - 5m
- Go/No-Go checklist review - 3m
- Blockers & escalations (who, plan) - 2m

Quick TL;DR:
- Target release window: 2026-03-12 02:00-05:00 PT (low-traffic) — tentative, awaiting infra confirmation for canary capacity.
- Current risk level: MEDIUM (infra autoscale validation outstanding + one regression flake in e2e).
- Decision target: firm go/no-go by EOD 2026-03-10 (allow one business day for emergency fixes and QA verification).

Go / No-Go checklist (call out owners and status)
1) Build artifacts: all green, images pushed to registry, tags: release/2026-03-12
   - Owner: Priya Kapoor
   - Status: DONE (2026-03-03)

2) Smoke tests on release artifacts: basic startup + healthchecks
   - Owner: Evan Ramirez
   - Status: DONE (2026-03-04)
   - Notes: small timeout tweak applied in container entrypoint; verified in staging.

3) End-to-end tests (critical user flows)
   - Owner: Harper Khan
   - Status: PARTIAL
   - Notes: 92% pass; one flaky test (payment retry flow) failing intermittently. Root cause suspected in mock service timing; QA to rerun with increased timeouts and isolated environment.
   - Action: Harper to schedule focused rerun by 2026-03-05 18:00 PT.

4) Infra readiness & canary capacity
   - Owner: SRE (oncall: Aisha Rahman)
   - Status: PENDING
   - Notes: Autoscaling policy needs verification for burst to 3x baseline; request to cloud team for temporary capacity reservation submitted (PR: infra/auto-scale-request-2026-03-04).
   - Action: Aisha to confirm capacity or provide rollback play by 2026-03-06 EOD.

5) Observability & alerting
   - Owner: Observability (Evan + SRE)
   - Status: PARTIAL
   - Notes: Dashboards created; missing one critical alert (high-latency on model init) — alert rule in review.
   - Action: Evan to merge alert PR by 2026-03-05 morning.

6) DB schema / migrations (backwards compatible?)
   - Owner: Platform-engineering (Priya)
   - Status: DONE
   - Notes: Migration is backwards compatible; tested on staging cluster. Migration window documented in playbook.

7) Rollback plan & playbook availability
   - Owner: Release-engineering (Jordan)
   - Status: DRAFT -> needs one more review
   - Notes: Playbook includes step-by-step rollback to last good tag + DB migration rollback notes. Need confirmation from PM on communication templates.
   - Action: Jordan to incorporate PM templates by 2026-03-05.

8) Customer comms / marketing coordination
   - Owner: Product Marketing (TBD: ask PM)
   - Status: PENDING
   - Notes: Email copy draft exists in Confluence (CONFLUENCE-RT-1234); need signoff.
   - Action: PM to get approval by 2026-03-09.

9) Compliance & security signoff (for Private customers changes)
   - Owner: Security & Compliance (security-request-queue)
   - Status: DONE
   - Notes: No new compliance blockers for this release.

10) Canary plan & metrics to evaluate
   - Owner: Jordan + Aisha
   - Status: PARTIAL
   - Metrics: error rate, 95th latency, model response correctness (synthetic prompts), resource utilization
   - Canary rollout: 5% -> 25% -> 50% -> 100% over 3 hours (with manual gates)
   - Action: Aisha to run dry-run of canary on staging on 2026-03-06 09:00 PT and report results.

Outstanding blockers (summary)
- e2e flaky test (payment retry) — blocks final QA signoff. Owner: Harper. ETA: 2026-03-05 evening.
- Infra autoscale validation/temporary capacity reservation — blocks ability to guarantee canary capacity at rollover. Owner: Aisha. ETA: 2026-03-06 EOD.
- Missing alert rule for model-init latency — risk for silent regressions. Owner: Evan. ETA: 2026-03-05 AM.

Mitigations / contingency:
- If canary capacity not confirmed, consider delaying release by 48 hours and run additional canary window while capacity request processed.
- If e2e test remains flaky after timeout adjustment, isolate the flow and consider skipping non-critical test for this release but create a hotfix CR and re-run post-release. (Note: coordinate with PM and SRE on risk acceptance.)

Meeting prep actions (before Thu sync):
- Priya: confirm migration docs and share rollforward steps (due 2026-03-05 12:00)
- Harper: rerun e2e focused suite, attach failure logs to JIRA JIRA-REL-987 (due 2026-03-05 18:00)
- Aisha: confirm autoscale capacity or provide rollback play; run staging canary dry-run 2026-03-06 09:00 PT (due 2026-03-06 EOD)
- Evan: merge alert rule for model-init latency and validate dashboard alerts (due 2026-03-05 10:00)
- Jordan: update release playbook with PM comms templates and finalize rollback steps (due 2026-03-05 17:00)

Communication checklist for go decision (if GO):
- Send internal all-eng slack + release-notes doc link (release-engineering to publish)
- PM to send customer-facing email (if relevant)
- Postmortem owner assigned for follow-ups (default: Jordan)

Decision log (placeholder)
- 2026-03-04: Preliminary assessment = PROCEED-IF (conditions met: autoscale confirmed, e2e pass reconfirmed)

Notes to self / scratchpad: 
- Keep the decision window tight — avoid scope creep in last 48h.
- Re-check canary health metrics frequency (15s granularity for first 30m, then 60s).
- Flag any regression in model-output quality to Research/Applied-ML immediately (Slack #applied-ml).

Follow-ups after meeting:
- Capture final go/no-go in Confluence and tag release ticket JIRA-REL-987.
- Schedule a quick post-release rollback drill within 48h even if GO.

-- end of notes --
